outcome: Hormone levels (oxytocin, cortisol, prolactin, interleukin-6, interleukin-10)
finding: This study suggests that KMC for mothers undergoing emergency cesarean section leads to increased levels of oxytocin, reduced cortisol and IL-6, and facilitates lactation behavior.
mod_finding: This study focused on the benefits of kangaroo mother care (KMC) for mothers undergoing emergency cesarean section, not on comparing different modes of delivery.
